verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is a cloud browser and AI-agent SaaS that processes user data, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions training-data use, an opt-out control, a data-retention policy, or any privacy commitment about model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
